tests.name: json_view_image_bounds_dump
tests.intent: Test that dumping a loaded document with bounds checking on floats and specific digit counts handles serialization safely.

tests.name: json_view_float_batch_boundary
tests.intent: Verify serialization output of various float fraction digit lengths around the 8 to 16 boundary.

tests.name: json_view_integer_digit_constraints
tests.intent: Verify float token processing when total digits are 16 or 17 with varying integer and fraction parts.

tests.name: json_view_empty_integer_part
tests.intent: Test serialization behavior for floating point numbers with zero integer digits and 8 to 16 fraction digits.

tests.name: json_view_load_full_check
tests.intent: Ensure json_document loads and dumps correctly with full check constraints enabled.

tests.name: json_view_load_none_check
tests.intent: Verify basic json document load and dump using none image check.

tests.name: json_view_ordered_dump
tests.intent: Check ordered json view document dumping preserves exact structure and values.

tests.name: json_view_materialize_comparison
tests.intent: Compare dump output of view root against materialized json object for floats.

tests.name: json_view_nested_array_floats
tests.intent: Dump deeply nested arrays containing floating point numbers with various precision profiles.

tests.name: json_view_object_keys_and_floats
tests.intent: Inspect serialization of objects mapping keys to high-precision float values.

tests.name: json_view_indentation_formatting
tests.intent: Test indented dump output on float-heavy json view documents.

tests.name: json_view_ensure_ascii_flag
tests.intent: Verify dump with ensure_ascii flag set on documents containing floats and strings.

tests.name: json_view_subelement_dump
tests.intent: Access and dump a specific subelement float node inside a json document view.

tests.name: json_view_invalid_utf8_bounds_check
tests.intent: Exercise error handling when dumping image under bounds check with invalid patterns.

tests.name: json_view_large_exponent_float
tests.intent: Test json document dump containing floats with explicit exponents.

tests.name: json_view_mixed_numeric_types
tests.intent: Check arrays mixing integers, standard floats, and high-precision floats.

tests.name: json_view_negative_floats
tests.intent: Test serialization of negative floating point values with extensive fraction lengths.

tests.name: json_view_parse_error_handling
tests.intent: Verify parse exception handling when input string is malformed.

tests.name: json_view_empty_containers
tests.intent: Test dump output on empty arrays and objects within json document view.

tests.name: json_view_roundtrip_save_load
tests.intent: Perform a save and load roundtrip on a complex document containing floats and verify dump equivalence.

tests.intent: Test dumping a float token with 16 total digits and 15 fraction digits via json_document bounds check load.
